structured.answer: I'm not sure how much I'd have. The page's example, with a 12,000 ₪ salary taken out after 5 years, shows "50,719 ₪" but then "29,768 ₪" going to tax, which scared me. As for when, at the top it says 6 years, or only 3 years for someone past retirement age like me. I'll ask you and the fund before I count on any number.

stuck.where: Calculator result text under the big bar chart (screen 3)
stuck.why: Three big numbers in one sentence: 50,719 goes in, 29,768 goes to tax, 15,794 comes back. I couldn't tell what I actually keep, and the white 'נשאר בידיים' bar has no number on it.
It assumes 6 years for everyone. Nowhere does it show the 3 years for retirement age that the top of the page talks about, so I don't know whether the tax part applies to me at all.
A second pair of amounts that don't match the first one, and English letters. I didn't know which number was mine.
It says 'עד 2% בשנה', the note below says 0.34%-0.74%, and the calculator used 0.54. Which one will I pay?
